lead_headline: The Carriage House opens at historic Tear-McFarlane mansion; foreclosure filings logged 71 new cases this week with zero exceeding $4M threshold

restaurant.blurb: 1 new lead today — The Carriage House (Cheesman Park, European café in historic Tear-McFarlane House, opened yesterday).

liquor.blurb: Fifth straight zero-application day — filing freeze now spans entire work week at unprecedented duration. Seven-day total locked at 8 applications, down 92% from previous week's 95 (which itself followed June's 152-filing backlog clear). No status changes, no removals. Post-maintenance baseline confirmed: weekly counts settling into low single digits after summer's database processing anomaly. Monitoring for August pattern break.

reputation.blurb: 68 mentions this week across 15 sources — down 9% from last week's 86 but still tracking above June averages. Instagram held dominance at 28 citations (41% share), followed by Facebook (11), Denver Post (10), Reddit (7). Weekend highlights: Alterra ski headquarters report amplified across business outlets; Fire on the Mountain expansion coverage; Union Station preservation feature drove engagement. Week averaged 9.7 mentions/day vs. prior 12.3 — natural pullback after four-week growth streak. YTD 1,167 mentions from 111 sources remains robust.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +1 yesterday (1 new, 0 canceled) — second consecutive clean day lifts MTD to −20 (−0.7/day). 90-day net holds at +87. Last week delivered +23 net after sharp reversal from prior week's −39, driven by mid-week acquisition spike (11 new on 7/23, 10 on 7/28). Monthly deficit narrowing but July still pacing as weakest since March. YTD +206 (+1.0/day) intact — requires August momentum to offset July's drag and sustain annual growth trajectory.
